title: fix(plugin-list): offer the In a queue filter only where the platform provisions the storage

Fixes #30372

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：外部（联邦）对象的列表不再显示「在队列中」筛选；普通的 `ownership: user` 对象照旧显示。
- 为什么改：外部对象虽然被注入了平台的 `queue` 列，但表结构归远端数据库，该列没有存储，任何一行都不可能进入队列，这个筛选只是噪音。
- 风险与回滚：风险低，只多了一个前置判断，读的是 spec 已有的 `platformProvisionsStorage`；回滚即还原 `ListView.tsx` 中那一行。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 的 `objectHasOwnershipQueue`（新增首行判断），再看同目录测试文件末尾新增的 describe 块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.queueSittingFilter-25769.test.tsx`，预期 15 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `objectHasOwnershipQueue` (plugin-list `ListView.tsx`) now also requires `platformProvisionsStorage(objectDef)` from `@objectstack/spec/data`. On an ADR-0015 `external` object the remote database owns the schema, so the injected `queue` column has no storage and no row can ever sit in a queue (assignment rules skip such objects through `carriesQueueColumn` already). The toggle `queueFilterOffered` therefore stays hidden there.
- The import joins the module's existing static `@objectstack/spec/data` import (`resolveInjectedSystemColumns`, `resolveSearchFieldResolution`), so it opens no new subpath in the Console's eager closure. `check:eager-closure` is CI's (Build and E2E UI); not measured locally.
- No `packages/**` change: per the server seat's measurement on the card, `/meta/object/...` already serves the `external` block, so the console can read the signal.

## Tests

Three pins as a new top-level `describe` in the existing harness `ListView.queueSittingFilter-25769.test.tsx`:
- `objectHasOwnershipQueue` is false on an external object carrying the injected column, in map and array `fields` form;
- a mounted list of an external object with the injected `queue` column and `hasAnyQueue: true` renders no toggle;
- an ordinary `ownership: 'user'` object still renders it.

The external fixture is spec-shaped (`datasource: 'legacy_erp'`, `external: { remoteName, writable: false }`).

## Acceptance notes

- The fix covers every federated object, not only read-only ones: the injected column is unprovisioned on all of them (server seat's reading on the card).

## Verification

All readings at head `9a22376034`, worktree on `origin/main` `a1d0b1ee9e`.
